literal_meaning: পাঁচ প্রকার ফুলের সাজি (a tray filled with five kinds of flowers)
figurative_meaning_en: A gathering of people of all sorts, good and bad, various kinds
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় পাঁচফুলের সাজির মতো নানা ধরনের লোকজন উপস্থিত ছিল।
এই বাজারে পাঁচফুলের সাজির মতো দোকানপাট দেখা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The party was like a tray of five flowers, with all sorts of people mingling.
The crowd in the market resembled a mixed tray of flowers, full of diverse vendors.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali rural customs where trays (saji) filled with five types of flowers symbolize abundance and variety, often used in festivals or offerings.
note: The imagery evokes rural Bengali traditions of floral arrangements in daily life and celebrations.
